newsitem.title: UK: MATIF names designated brokers for LYS contracts.
newsitem.headline: MATIF names designated brokers for LYS contracts.

text.p: French futures and options exchange MATIF has appointed four designated brokers for its new long-term yield spread contracts (LYS) to be launched on Friday, MATIF said on Wednesday.
The brokers are Paresco Futures, Fiancor, Ifitec and Trifutures.

The contracts will be based on yield spreads calculated on benchmarks as close as possible to 10 years. Initially four contracts will be introduced, the OAT/Bund, BTP/Bund, Obligaciones/Bund and T-note/Bund.

"LYS is part of a new generation of futures contract bringing added value to market participants," said Jean-Francois Conil-Lacoste, managing director of MATIF's London office, speaking at a news conference.
"The net result for the end user is a simple tool, which is the quintessence of the futures market."
Conil-Lacoste said the LYS market was not expected to be a 'jumbo' market but would be ideally suited to being traded on Globex.
He said the contracts would take advantage of the economic convergence leading up to and during European economic and monetary union (EMU) as well as in a global context.
More contracts might be added later if the product proved successful, Conil-Lacoste said.
